requirement.text: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.

classification.rationale: The requirement refers to on-board equipment performing a self-test within ERTMS (European Rail Traffic Management System), which is an embedded railway control system rather than a web, mobile, or AI application.

rounds.text_checked: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.

test_strategy.rationale: State-based testing applies because 'Start Up' represents a specific system state transition that triggers the automatic self-test. Use case testing applies because starting up the on-board equipment represents a multi-step operational scenario with a documented dependency involving requirement PURE-ERTMS-R8.

test_cases.title: Automatic Self-Test Triggered on Start Up Transition
test_cases.preconditions: The ERTMS on-board equipment is powered OFF.
steps: Supply power to the ERTMS on-board equipment to trigger the Start Up state transition.
Monitor system diagnostic logs and hardware indicators during initialization.
test_cases.expected_result: The on-board equipment automatically initiates and executes its internal self-test routine upon entering the Start Up state without manual intervention.

test_cases.title: Start Up Operational Flow with Self-Test Result Indication
test_cases.preconditions: The ERTMS on-board equipment is powered off and connected to the Driver Machine Interface (DMI).
steps: Perform the standard Start Up operational workflow.
Observe the automated execution of the on-board self-test during power-on.
Verify that the self-test produces a result to be indicated on the DMI.
test_cases.expected_result: The automatic self-test completes successfully as part of the Start Up sequence and yields a self-test result for the DMI.

final_text: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.
